build: Modwerk's linker: Modwerk base 0c92aa45 (core-ar2 0.7, the base of the author's combined images) + this folder's compiled Silent Pad+Trig 0.6.0-experimental, materialised against the owner's stock OS 1.74, --version PS12

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: a card image with no calibration, JIT on

conditions: Headless cold boot on a card image; six NO presses clear the notices; GLOBAL, six DOWNs and YES open CONTROL; two DOWNs and YES open SEQUENCER CONFIG; five DOWNs reach MUTE ALL SOUND, all three new rows unchecked; two UPs reach SILENT PAD+TRIG and YES checks it; the keys move to MUTE ALL SOUND and YES checks it; four NOs leave the menus; pad SD is pressed (silent), then FUNC + SD. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified. The run also changed SAMPLE POS RES, in that run only.
